messages:
jordan: Quick callout from design review: team pushed two alternatives for the usage dashboard row. One is a compact "row" with date sparkline + quick delta, the other is a detailed ledger card showing token-type bars and a small invoice CTA. Links: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/usage-rows
sophia: For listing pages I prefer compact rows. Folks scan lots of projects, so density > immediate breakdown. Detailed card for the project detail page makes sense.
ben: agree on density. One ask: if compact row has a popover for token breakdown on click, will that require extra network calls? If so might be slow for many quick opens.
cassie: backend: we can include a small cached breakdown payload in the listing response (0.5 KB per project) and lazy hydrate on first open. Should be fine.
jordan: mobile question: do we show the sparkline or replace with a tiny stacked pill? On narrow screens sparklines disappear and look like noise.
sophia: show a single summarized bar + percentage change on mobile. Tap expands to full breakdown in a modal.
ben: accessibility note: ensure popover/modal has role="dialog" and focus trap. Also provide a text summary for screen readers: "Project X spent $Y this month; token split: embeddings 60%, prompts 30%, outputs 10%"
a11y-bot: recommended a11y checklist posted: https://intra.docs/a11y/usage-breakdown-checklist.md :white_check_mark:
jordan: invoice download placement debate again: current proposal places "Download invoice" inline on org header and inside project actions menu. Some PMs want both. Thoughts?
sophia: inline on org header makes sense because invoices are org-scoped. For projects, include "Export project billing (CSV)" in actions menu instead of invoice to avoid confusion.
cassie: backend: CSV export endpoint for projects exists; PDF invoices are org-only right now. We should clarify copy to prevent support tickets.
jordan: copy proposal: Org header: "Download invoice (PDF)". Project actions: "Export usage (CSV)". Also add helper tooltip: "Invoices are billed at org level".
ben: will add telemetry events for both CTAs: invoice_pdf_clicked, project_csv_exported. Also ensure the CSV includes per-token columns.
sophia: visual: add a micro-legend to the compact row that toggles color-blind pattern fills in settings. Some folks asked for that in the last design crit.
a11y-bot: suggest aria-pressed toggle and preference persisted to user settings. Include examples for patterned SVG fills.
jordan: final Q: default for org listing page: ledger cards or compact rows? We need to pick one for the alpha release.
sophia: recommend ledger cards for org page (since finance teams land there) and compact rows for project lists.
cassie: deploy-wise we can gate ledger card render behind a feature flag (ui.billing.ledger_cards=true) so we can roll it out.
jordan: action items: sophia: update mocks for mobile + copy; ben: add telemetry + aria examples; cassie: feature flag + hydrate payload; a11y-bot: publish checklist link to docs channel.
a11y-bot: checklist link posted to #docs and scheduled review for Friday 10am PT.
jordan: thanks all, will schedule a short sync tomorrow to confirm designs before handoff. :calendar:
